face_label_caveat: Label-based. The 10-11 Standard UNDER cells and the rule-4-for-NFL ruling were computed on pick_type that step1 never stored (defaulted to Standard downstream); Demon/Goblin rungs are mixed into the 'Standard' rows. Only slate dates with step1 pick_type persisted (2026-10-23+, plus 09-20/09-21/09-24) are real faces. Forward counting must use utils.face_ladder status == verified. See data/reports/face_contamination_2026-10-24.md.
